hooks.command: bash -c "INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo \"$INPUT\" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo \"$CMD\" | grep -qE '^\s*(pip install|pip3 install|npm install|npm i |yarn add|pnpm add|pnpm install)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Docker-first policy. Add dependency to requirements.txt or package.json and rebuild with: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0"
